name: de_component_tool
description: Designer tool - Component tool to perform actions like create component instances, get all components and more.

siteId.description: Unique identifier for the Webflow site (e.g., '580e63e98c9a982ac9b8b741'). Use list_sites to discover available site IDs.

label.description: Label echoed in the response for this action item. It does not select which action runs.

check_if_inside_component_view.description: Check if inside component view. this helpful to make changes to the component

anyOf.description: Run check_if_inside_component_view: Check if inside component view. this helpful to make changes to the component

close_component_view.description: Close a component instance view. it will close and open the page view.

anyOf.description: Run close_component_view: Close a component instance view. it will close and open the page view.

name.description: The name of the blank component to create

group.description: Optional group/folder to place the component in

create_blank_component.description: Create a blank component with no root element. Equivalent to 'Create blank' in the Designer's New Component menu.

anyOf.description: Run create_blank_component: Create a blank component with no root element. Equivalent to 'Create blank' in the Designer's New Component menu.

component_id.description: The ID of the component to add the props to.

type.description: The structural type of the prop to create.

group.description: Optional group/folder name. Props with the same group appear together in the props panel.

tooltip.description: Optional tooltip text shown on hover in the props panel.

rich_text_inner_text.description: Default inner text content. Only used when type is "richText".

multiline.description: Whether the text input supports multiple lines. Only used when type is "textContent" or "string".

default_text.description: Settings for text-based props. Use "value" for string/textContent/id/altText/image, or "rich_text_inner_text" for richText.

value.description: Default value. Only used when type is "number".

min.description: Minimum allowed value. Only used when type is "number".

max.description: Maximum allowed value. Only used when type is "number".

decimals.description: Number of decimal places allowed. Only used when type is "number".

value.description: Default value. Only used when type is "boolean".

true_label.description: Label shown when the value is true. Only used when type is "boolean".

false_label.description: Label shown when the value is false. Only used when type is "boolean".

to.description: Link target. For url/email/phone: literal value. For page: pageId. For file: assetId. For collectionPage: pageSlug. Not used for pageSection — use to_element_id instead.

component.description: Component-scope ID. Pass the value of element.id.component verbatim — do not invent or shorten it.

element.description: Element ID within the component scope. Pass the value of element.id.element verbatim — do not invent or shorten it.

to_element_id.description: Target element id (component + element) for the pageSection link. Only used when mode is "pageSection".

open_in_new_tab.description: Whether the link opens in a new tab.

email_subject.description: Email subject. Only used when mode is "email".

rel.description: The rel attribute for the link.

create_prop.description: Create one or more new prop definitions on a component in a single transaction. If any prop fails validation, no props are created. Supports 10 creatable prop types (textContent, string, richText, image, link, video, number, boolean, id, altText). All per-type settings (default value, multiline for text, min/max/decimals for number, true_label/false_label for boolean) live inside the matching group object: default_text, default_number, default_boolean, default_link, default_video. Use get_component or get_all_components first to discover the component_id.

anyOf.description: Run create_prop: Create one or more new prop definitions on a component in a single transaction. If any prop fails validation, no props are created. Supports 10 creatable prop types (textContent, string, richText, image, link, video, number, boolean, id, altText). All per-type settings (default value, multiline for text, min/max/decimals for number, true_label/false_label for boolean) live inside the matching group object: default_text, default_number, default_boolean, default_link, default_video. Use get_component or get_all_components first to discover the component_id.

name.description: The name for the new variant

create_variant.description: Create a new variant on a component with a specified name.

anyOf.description: Run create_variant: Create a new variant on a component with a specified name.

variant_id.description: The id of the variant to delete

delete_variant.description: Delete a variant from a component by ID. The base variant cannot be deleted.

anyOf.description: Run delete_variant: Delete a variant from a component by ID. The base variant cannot be deleted.

source_component_id.description: The ID of the component to duplicate

name.description: The name for the duplicated component

group.description: Optional group/folder to place the component in

description.description: Optional description for the duplicated component

duplicate_component.description: Duplicate an existing component with a new name. Copies the component structure from the source component.

anyOf.description: Run duplicate_component: Duplicate an existing component with a new name. Copies the component structure from the source component.

source_variant_id.description: The id of the variant to duplicate. Use 'base' to duplicate the base variant.

name.description: The name for the duplicated variant

duplicate_variant.description: Duplicate an existing variant on a component. Copies settings and styles from the source variant.

anyOf.description: Run duplicate_variant: Duplicate an existing variant on a component. Copies settings and styles from the source variant.

get_all_components.description: Get all components, only valid if you are connected to Webflow Designer.

anyOf.description: Run get_all_components: Get all components, only valid if you are connected to Webflow Designer.

component_id.description: The id of the component to get. Use this or name.

name.description: The name of the component. Use this or component_id.

group.description: Optional group to narrow the search when using name

get_component.description: Get a component by ID or by name. Provide component_id for ID lookup, or name (and optional group) for name lookup.

anyOf.description: Run get_component: Get a component by ID or by name. Provide component_id for ID lookup, or name (and optional group) for name lookup.

resolved_value.description: Whether to return resolved prop values. Defaults to false.

get_component_instance_props.description: Get all prop definitions and their current values for a component instance element.

anyOf.description: Run get_component_instance_props: Get all prop definitions and their current values for a component instance element.

get_current_component.description: Get the component currently being edited on the canvas (in-context editing or component canvas). Returns null if on a regular page.

anyOf.description: Run get_current_component: Get the component currently being edited on the canvas (in-context editing or component canvas). Returns null if on a regular page.

get_parent_component.description: Get the component that contains the specified element. Returns null if the element is at page level (not inside a component).

anyOf.description: Run get_parent_component: Get the component that contains the specified element. Returns null if the element is at page level (not inside a component).

variant_id.description: The id of the variant to retrieve. Use 'base' for the base variant.

get_variant_settings.description: Get the settings (name, id, selection state) of a specific variant on a component.

anyOf.description: Run get_variant_settings: Get the settings (name, id, selection state) of a specific variant on a component.

variant_id.description: The id of the variant to read styles from. Use 'base' for the base variant.

style_name.description: The name of the style to read properties from

breakpoint_id.description: The breakpoint to get styles for

pseudo.description: The pseudo class to get styles for

get_variant_styles.description: Get the styles applied to a specific variant on a component. Returns style properties scoped to the variant, independent of the base component styles.

anyOf.description: Run get_variant_styles: Get the styles applied to a specific variant on a component. Returns style properties scoped to the variant, independent of the base component styles.

component_id.description: The id of the component to insert

creation_position.description: The position to create component instance on. append/prepend insert as child of the parent element. before/after insert as sibling adjacent to the target element.

insert_component_instance.description: Insert a component on current active page.

anyOf.description: Run insert_component_instance: Insert a component on current active page.

component_id.description: The id of the component to open in the canvas. Use this or page_id.

page_id.description: The id of the page to navigate to. Use this to exit the component canvas and return to a page.

open_canvas.description: Navigate the Designer canvas to a component or page. Use component_id to open a component canvas, or page_id to navigate to a page (e.g. to exit component canvas). Provide exactly one of component_id or page_id.

anyOf.description: Run open_canvas: Navigate the Designer canvas to a component or page. Use component_id to open a component canvas, or page_id to navigate to a page (e.g. to exit component canvas). Provide exactly one of component_id or page_id.

open_component_view.description: Open a component instance view for changes or reading.

anyOf.description: Run open_component_view: Open a component instance view for changes or reading.

label.description: A label to identify this query in the results.

keywords.description: Search keywords. Each keyword is matched case-insensitively as a substring against component name, group, and description. All keywords must match (AND). Each keyword can match any field (OR).

hasProps.description: When true, only return components that have props. When false, only return components without props.

propsFilter.description: Filter to components that have at least one prop matching these criteria. Fields are ANDed; values within a field are ORed.

includeProps.description: When true, include component prop definitions in the response.

includeInstanceCount.description: When true, include the instance count for the component.

includeVariants.description: When true, include all variant definitions in the response.

includeVariant.description: When provided, include the variant with this ID in the response. Use 'base' for the base variant.

includeSelectedVariant.description: When true, include the currently selected variant in the response.

filterProps.description: Filter which props to include. Fields are ANDed together; values within a field are ORed.

resultOptions.description: Options to control what is included in the response.

isLibrary.description: When true, only return library components (imported from an installed library). When false, exclude library components.

isCodeComponent.description: When true, only return code components (DevLink, Site AI, Library AI). When false, exclude code components.

limit.description: Max results for this query. Default: 50, Max: 200.

query_components.description: Query components with filtering by keywords, prop characteristics, and more. Supports multiple labeled queries per call.

anyOf.description: Run query_components: Query components with filtering by keywords, prop characteristics, and more. Supports multiple labeled queries per call.

component_id.description: The ID of the component whose props will be removed.

prop_ids.description: The IDs of the props to remove.

remove_prop.description: Remove one or more prop definitions from a component. Each prop_id is removed independently; errors on individual props are reported without aborting the rest. Use get_component (with includeProps) first to discover prop_ids.

anyOf.description: Run remove_prop: Remove one or more prop definitions from a component. Each prop_id is removed independently; errors on individual props are reported without aborting the rest. Use get_component (with includeProps) first to discover prop_ids.

variant_ids.description: Ordered list of variant IDs. Use 'base' for the base variant. A full list sets the exact order; a partial list moves the specified variants while preserving the relative order of omitted ones.

reorder_variants.description: Reorder the variants of a component. Pass an ordered list of variant IDs (including 'base') to set the desired order. A partial list moves the specified variants to those positions while leaving others in their relative order.

anyOf.description: Run reorder_variants: Reorder the variants of a component. Pass an ordered list of variant IDs (including 'base') to set the desired order. A partial list moves the specified variants to those positions while leaving others in their relative order.

reset_all_props_value.description: Reset all prop values on a component instance element back to their default values.

anyOf.description: Run reset_all_props_value: Reset all prop values on a component instance element back to their default values.

type.description: The type of value to set.

string_value.description: The string value. Required when type is "string".

number_value.description: The number value. Required when type is "number".

boolean_value.description: The boolean value. Required when type is "boolean".

link_mode.description: The link mode. Required when type is "link".

link_to.description: The link target. For url/email/phone: the literal value. For page: pageId. For file: assetId. For collectionPage: pageSlug. For pageSection: elementId.

link_to_component_id.description: The component ID of the target element. Only used when link_mode is "pageSection".

link_open_in_new_tab.description: Whether the link opens in a new tab.

link_email_subject.description: The email subject. Only used when link_mode is email.

link_rel.description: The rel attribute for the link.

video_src.description: The video source URL. Required when type is "video".

binding_source_type.description: The binding source type. Required when type is "bindable".

binding_prop_id.description: The prop ID to bind to. Required when binding_source_type is "prop".

binding_collection_id.description: The CMS collection ID. Required when binding_source_type is "cms".

binding_field_id.description: The CMS field ID. Required when binding_source_type is "cms".

binding_field_key.description: The field key. Required when binding_source_type is "page", "locale", or "localeItem".

set_component_instance_prop_values.description: Set prop values on a component instance element. Use get_component_instance_props first to discover available prop IDs and their types.

anyOf.description: Run set_component_instance_prop_values: Set prop values on a component instance element. Use get_component_instance_props first to discover available prop IDs and their types.

set_component_metadata.description: Update metadata (name, group, description) of a component

anyOf.description: Run set_component_metadata: Update metadata (name, group, description) of a component

variant_id.description: The id of the variant to update. Use 'base' for the base variant.

name.description: The new display name for the variant

set_variant_name.description: Update the name of a variant on a component. Use 'base' as the variant_id to rename the base variant.

anyOf.description: Run set_variant_name: Update the name of a variant on a component. Use 'base' as the variant_id to rename the base variant.

variant_id.description: The id of the variant to apply styles to. Use 'base' for the base variant.

style_name.description: The name of the style to update

breakpoint_id.description: The breakpoint to set the style for

pseudo.description: The pseudo class to set the style for

variable_as_value.description: The variable id to use as the value

properties.description: The CSS properties to set or update on the variant style

remove_properties.description: The CSS property names to remove from the variant style

set_variant_styles.description: Set or update styles on a specific variant. Style changes are scoped to the variant and do not affect the base component or other variants.

anyOf.description: Run set_variant_styles: Set or update styles on a specific variant. Style changes are scoped to the variant and do not affect the base component or other variants.

replace.description: Whether to replace the source element on the canvas with a new instance of the created component. Defaults to true. Pass false to keep the original element in place.

transform_element_to_component.description: Transform an element to a component

anyOf.description: Run transform_element_to_component: Transform an element to a component

unlink_component_instance.description: Unlink a component instance, converting it back into regular editable elements. Returns the new root element ID and type. Cannot be used on library or code components.

anyOf.description: Run unlink_component_instance: Unlink a component instance, converting it back into regular editable elements. Returns the new root element ID and type. Cannot be used on library or code components.

component_id.description: The id of the component to unregister

unregister_component.description: Unregister a component. DANGEROUS ACTION. USE WITH CAUTION.

anyOf.description: Run unregister_component: Unregister a component. DANGEROUS ACTION. USE WITH CAUTION.

component_id.description: The ID of the component whose props will be updated.

prop_id.description: The ID of the prop to update.

name.description: New display name for the prop.

group.description: New group/folder name, or null to ungroup. Props with the same group appear together in the props panel.

tooltip.description: New tooltip text, or null to clear.

clear_default_value.description: Set true to clear the prop's default value. Takes precedence over value fields inside the groups.

value.description: New default value for "string", "textContent", "id", "altText", or "image" (asset ID).

multiline.description: Whether the text input supports multiple lines. Only applies to "textContent" or "string" props.

default_text.description: Settings for text-based props. Use "value" for string/textContent/id/altText/image, or "rich_text_inner_text" for richText.

value.description: New default value. Only applies to "number" props.

min.description: New minimum allowed value, or null to clear. Only applies to "number" props.

max.description: New maximum allowed value, or null to clear. Only applies to "number" props.

decimals.description: New number of decimal places allowed, or null to clear. Only applies to "number" props.

value.description: New default value. Only applies to "boolean" props.

true_label.description: New label shown when the value is true, or null to clear. Only applies to "boolean" props.

false_label.description: New label shown when the value is false, or null to clear. Only applies to "boolean" props.

to.description: New link target. For url/email/phone: literal value. For page: pageId. For file: assetId. For collectionPage: pageSlug. Not used for pageSection — use to_element_id instead.

to_element_id.description: Target element id (component + element) for the pageSection link. Only used when mode is "pageSection".

open_in_new_tab.description: Whether the link opens in a new tab.

email_subject.description: New email subject. Only used when mode is "email".

rel.description: New rel attribute for the link.

update_prop.description: Update one or more existing prop definitions on a component. Only the provided fields are changed; omitted fields stay the same. All per-type settings (default value, multiline, min/max/decimals, true_label/false_label, link and video settings) live inside the matching group object: default_text, default_number, default_boolean, default_link, default_video. The type itself is immutable. Use clear_default_value: true to clear the default. Numeric and label fields accept null to clear constraints. Use get_component_instance_props or get_component (with includeProps) first to discover prop_ids.

anyOf.description: Run update_prop: Update one or more existing prop definitions on a component. Only the provided fields are changed; omitted fields stay the same. All per-type settings (default value, multiline, min/max/decimals, true_label/false_label, link and video settings) live inside the matching group object: default_text, default_number, default_boolean, default_link, default_video. The type itself is immutable. Use clear_default_value: true to clear the default. Numeric and label fields accept null to clear constraints. Use get_component_instance_props or get_component (with includeProps) first to discover prop_ids.

actions.description: Actions to execute sequentially. Each array item must include label and exactly one action property: check_if_inside_component_view, close_component_view, create_blank_component, create_prop, create_variant, delete_variant, duplicate_component, duplicate_variant, get_all_components, get_component, get_component_instance_props, get_current_component, get_parent_component, get_variant_settings, get_variant_styles, insert_component_instance, open_canvas, open_component_view, query_components, remove_prop, reorder_variants, reset_all_props_value, set_component_instance_prop_values, set_component_metadata, set_variant_name, set_variant_styles, transform_element_to_component, unlink_component_instance, unregister_component, update_prop.

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."
